gloss: sales office; business office; branch office

definitions.gloss: sales office; business office; (local) branch office
definitions.explanation: A local office of a company that handles sales, customer service, or regional operations — typically smaller than a headquarters or {支店|してん} (branch), and often focused on logistics, pickups, deliveries, or regional clients. Common for shipping companies, utilities, and sales-driven businesses.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}した→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I called the nearest branch office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}れます→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: You can pick up the package at your nearest branch office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{打|う}ち{合|あ}わせ→打ち合わせ：07155_uchiawase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: For the new business deal, we held a meeting at the Osaka branch office.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧ (business, sales) and ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place). Most Japanese learners first encounter the word with delivery companies — ⟦{宅配|たくはい}{便|びん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧ companies like ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ} or {佐川急便|さがわきゅうびん} call their local pickup/drop-off centers {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最寄|もよ}り→最寄り：28821_moyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}: the nearest branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧: to make an inquiry at the branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}{止|ど}め: "hold at branch office" (for package delivery)
- ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧{営業所|えいぎょうしょ}: the Osaka branch office
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧: branch office manager

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧: branch (of a chain store, bank, etc.) — typically larger and more full-service than a {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}
- ⟦{本社|ほんしゃ}→本社：09565_honsha⟧: head office, headquarters
- {事業所|じぎょうしょ}: business establishment — a broader legal/accounting term covering any workplace of a company
- ⟦{出張所|しゅっちょうじょ}→出張所：18505_shucchoujo⟧: sub-office, local outlet — usually smaller than a {営業所|えいぎょうしょ}
